import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,re
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,o):
 s=o if isinstance(o,str) else json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True); assert z.returncode==0
v=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())
for mid,x in v.items():
 x['decoded_statement_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(x['object']['statement'].encode()).hexdigest(); print(mid,x['object']['statement'])
write('raw-provenance.json',v)
allow=json.loads((p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); print('allow type',type(allow).__name__)
paths=allow if isinstance(allow,list) else allow['paths']
protected=('hat','crown','tournament','bunkbed','code-loop','polynexus')
inventory=[]; hits=[]
for s in paths:
 if any(t in Path(s).name.lower() or t in str(Path(s).parent.name).lower() for t in protected):
  inventory.append({'path':s,'state':'protected-filtered-before-open'}); continue
 f=Path(s); b=f.read_bytes(); o=json.loads(b); inventory.append({'path':s,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'state':'read exact allowlisted JSON'})
 txt=b.decode()
 if any(mid in txt for mid in v) or any(t in txt.lower() for t in ['knödel','knodel','domatic','braid graph','350549','354377','bdd','bci','torsion']):
  hits.append({'path':s,'content':o}); print('HISTORY MATCH',s,txt[:2200])
write('history-inventory.json',inventory); write('history-matches.json',hits)
q=['"Knödel" "domination" "conjecture" Racicot Rosso','"domatic" "Cartesian" "conjecture" Francis Rajendraprasad','"braid graphs" "isometric dimension" conjecture']
plan={'batch':1,'queries':q,'charged_ids':['349582','350144','350145','350521'],'used_batches':1,'used_queries':3,'remaining_batches':2,'remaining_queries':6,'state':'precharged before native call'}
assert plan['used_batches']<=3 and plan['used_queries']<=9
write('search-plan-batch1.json',plan); write('search-budget.json',plan)
